provenance.asset_description: Three images overlayed over a blurred background. The image on the left is a blue skinned humanoid wearing plain clothes with feathers and paintbrushes in their hair. The image in the top right corner is of a strange handmade tome crafted from rat leather with the Glyph of the Open Road on the front. The third image in the bottom right corner is a portrait of Venture-Captain Amara Li with her hair pulled back and bunned with two daggers.
